key_facts: UPDATED Wednesday July 8 (T+1d, final day before Thursday July 9 pricing / July 10 Nasdaq debut): Shifted Alibaba 0.62 -> 0.70, SK Hynix 0.38 -> 0.30. CRITICAL PRICE DROP BELOW ALIBABA RECORD: (1) On Wednesday July 8 in Seoul, KOSPI plunged another -5.4% to 7,246.79 and SK Hynix tumbled -5.68% to close at 2,076,000 KRW (-14.4% in 3 sessions from Friday July 3 2,425,000 KRW), amid AI capex reassessment and single-stock 2x leveraged ETF turmoil (Korea Herald/Yonhap). Even with the Korean won strengthening +29.7 won to 1,498.5 KRW/USD at 3:30 p.m. KST, SK Hynix's hard legal cap of 17.79M shares (177.9M ADSs; no upsize/greenshoe possible due to SK Square >=20% holding-company floor) dropped -$0.98B to just 36.93T KRW = $24.646B at 0% discount — now -$0.38B (-1.54%) BELOW Alibaba's $25.03B all-time record with ONLY ONE KRX session (Thu July 9) left before NY pricing. (2) Overnight/Wed NY close signals are sharply mixed: US chips bounced (SOX +2.23%, Nvidia +3.65%, Broadcom +4.8%, Nasdaq +0.20%) and foreigners were net buyers (+336B KRW) in Seoul Wed, BUT Trump declared the US-Iran ceasefire "over" and warned of strikes Wednesday night, sending Brent crude +5.2%, Dow -1.09%, and adding KRW/postponement tail risk. (3) Bullish SK Hynix offsets keeping 30% alive: Bloomberg/Straits Times (July 8) report the ADR book is "multiple times oversubscribed" (~1,000 institutional investors, $7B anchor interest from Baillie Gifford/Coatue/Situational Awareness Partners) and non-fungibility limits on converting KRX shares to ADRs could tighten the offering discount toward 0% or slight premium if KRX bounces +2% to +4% Thursday. Monte Carlo across Thu KRX/FX, offering spread, ~6% delay risk, and ~15% secondary-ADR vs strict-IPO classification risk yields Alibaba 0.70 / SK Hynix 0.30.
next_review_trigger: Thursday July 9 KRX close/FX and Thursday July 9 NY final ADR pricing announcement (proceeds vs $25.03B Alibaba record).
